metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the morning tally, two lines in the almanac, Ferdinand's name, and the tally after the last play.

yesterday: Twenty-four stood through the morning. Thirty-five lines, and one whole song, is what Garnish said after the yard.
The almanac says Shrove Tuesday and my lord's birthday. You drank the health.
The trestles are stacked. They are the inn's. Tomorrow the house is dark.
You heard the apprentices harder than the holiday explains. Ash Wednesday begins at church.
